unavailable.name: MOBI转PDF
unavailable.reason: MOBI转PDF is not available offline: the 手机 container needs LibreOffice, which BrowserSnip does not bundle (~100 MB of WASM). 将书籍重新保存为 EPUB — Calibre 直接导出 — BrowserSnip 完全在选项卡中进行转换。

unavailable.name: 页面转 PDF
unavailable.reason: 页面转 PDF is not available offline: the 苹果页面 container needs LibreOffice, which BrowserSnip does not bundle (~100 MB of WASM). 在页面中选择文件 → 导出到 → PDF。 .pages 捆绑包是一个 ZIP：如果它已经包含 PDF，则可以使用该文件。

unavailable.name: PUB 转 PDF
unavailable.reason: PUB 转 PDF is not available offline: the 微软出版商 container needs LibreOffice, which BrowserSnip does not bundle (~100 MB of WASM). 在 LibreOffice 或 Publisher 中打开并另存为 DOCX 或 PDF；两者都在选项卡中转换。

unavailable.name: VSD 转 PDF
unavailable.reason: VSD 转 PDF is not available offline: the 微软Visio container needs LibreOffice, which BrowserSnip does not bundle (~100 MB of WASM). 从Visio导出到PDF，或者将绘图保存为SVG并使用SVG到PDF来绘制图稿。

unavailable.name: WPD 转 PDF
unavailable.reason: WPD 转 PDF is not available offline: the WordPerfect container needs LibreOffice, which BrowserSnip does not bundle (~100 MB of WASM). 首先从 Corel WordPerfect 或 LibreOffice 重新导出为 DOCX 或 PDF。

unavailable.name: WPS转PDF
unavailable.reason: WPS转PDF is not available offline: the 金山作家 container needs LibreOffice, which BrowserSnip does not bundle (~100 MB of WASM). 在WPS Office中重新另存为DOCX，在选项卡中进行转换。

unavailable.name: ODG 转 PDF
unavailable.reason: ODG 转 PDF is not available offline: the 开放文档绘图 container needs LibreOffice, which BrowserSnip does not bundle (~100 MB of WASM). 从 LibreOffice Draw 中将绘图导出为 SVG 或 PNG 并使用这些转换器来保留图稿。
